name: Mistral Team
description: High-signal Mistral AI releases from official Mistral channels.
headline: Verified Mistral releases across {days} days.
subtitle: October 2025 — May 2026. Official Mistral model/platform releases plus flagship Mistral events.
footnote: Cross-checked on May 9, 2026 against official Mistral announcements, the Mistral docs changelog, and event pages.

releases.title: Le Chat Team and Le Chat Enterprise rebranded
releases.description: Mistral rebranded its workspace tier to Le Chat Team and shipped Le Chat Enterprise with SCIM, audit log streaming, and connectors for Google Drive, SharePoint, GitHub, and GitLab.

releases.title: Codestral Mamba 2 open weights
releases.description: Mistral released Codestral Mamba 2 (7B) on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, with a 256k context window for long-file completion and a Mistral Inference reference runtime.

releases.title: Mistral Large 2 announced
releases.description: Mistral introduced Large 2 with improved multilingual reasoning and enterprise latency profiles, including stable JSON outputs and an upgraded function-calling schema.

releases.title: Le Chat Projects and shared spaces
releases.description: Le Chat added Projects: long-lived workspaces with shared system prompts, custom connectors, document libraries, and per-project audit views for Le Chat Team and Enterprise plans.

releases.title: Pixtral Large 2 multimodal model
releases.description: Mistral published Pixtral Large 2 with stronger DocVQA, ChartQA, and OCR-Bench numbers, plus a 200k multimodal context window for long PDFs and slide decks.

releases.title: Document OCR pipeline update
releases.description: Mistral enhanced document processing with improved OCR extraction, layout-aware parsing, and a typed schema output that pipes directly into Le Chat Projects and the Mistral API.

releases.title: Le Chat Voice (Voxtral) GA
releases.description: Mistral promoted Le Chat Voice to GA on iOS, Android, and Le Chat web, powered by the Voxtral speech stack with sub-second turn latency in eight languages.

releases.title: Magistral Medium 2 reasoning model
releases.description: Mistral released Magistral Medium 2, an open-weights reasoning model with stable chain-of-thought streaming, structured outputs, and a /think slash command in Le Chat.

releases.title: Mistral Agents API GA
releases.description: Mistral promoted the Agents API to GA with run-and-resume sessions, scoped tool use, JSON-schema enforcement, and a documented Agents-to-Agents handoff pattern.

releases.title: Codestral MCP server for IDEs
releases.description: Mistral released a first-party Codestral MCP server with project-aware code completion, refactor, and review tools for use inside Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs.

releases.title: Codestral enterprise features
releases.description: Mistral expanded Codestral for enterprise with policy controls, repository-level governance, and an on-prem completion server with per-team usage analytics.

releases.title: Mistral AI at NVIDIA GTC 2026
releases.description: Mistral AI participated at NVIDIA GTC 2026 with sessions and meetings around open models, optimization, inference, and deployment at scale.

releases.title: Le Chat Deep Research
releases.description: Mistral added Le Chat Deep Research, a multi-step research mode that plans, searches, and synthesizes a sourced report with downloadable Markdown, PDF, and DOCX exports.

releases.title: Mistral On-Prem Helm chart and air-gapped runtime
releases.description: Mistral published an official Helm chart and air-gapped runtime for self-hosted deployments of Mistral Small, Medium, Magistral, and Codestral on customer Kubernetes clusters.

releases.title: Le Chat Canvas for documents and code
releases.description: Mistral added Le Chat Canvas, a side-by-side editing surface for long documents and code with inline edit suggestions, diff view, and revision history.

releases.title: Pixtral Large 2.1 with video understanding
releases.description: Pixtral Large 2.1 added video understanding (up to 60s clips at 1fps), improved chart parsing, and a structured-output mode aligned with the Agents API tool schema.

releases.title: Mistral Small 4 released
releases.description: Mistral released Small 4 optimized for low-latency deployment and cost-sensitive production workloads, with a 128k context window and Apache 2.0 weights for the base checkpoint.

releases.title: Mistral Medium 3.5 released
releases.description: Mistral released Mistral Medium 3.5, a frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases with adjustable reasoning via reasoning_effort, under a Modified MIT license.

releases.title: Mistral Medium 3.5 in Le Chat
releases.description: Le Chat upgraded its default model to Mistral Medium 3.5 across Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise tiers, with a per-conversation reasoning-effort toggle in the composer.

releases.title: Fine-tuning for Mistral Medium 3.5
releases.description: Mistral opened fine-tuning for Mistral Medium 3.5 in la Plateforme with LoRA adapters, evaluation hooks, and signed deployment artifacts that route through the Agents API.

releases.title: Mistral AI Now Summit
releases.description: Mistral AI hosts AI Now Summit in Paris, a flagship event for leaders and builders focused on industrializing AI and moving from POC to production.
